summary: Rename the table, keep an updatable view under the old name until the old version is retired.

stages.description: The old version keeps using the old name through an auto-updatable view.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_customerevent RENAME TO account_customer_event
CREATE VIEW account_customerevent AS SELECT * FROM account_customer_event

stages.description: Deploy the new version; its migration only updates Django state.
No version uses the old name any more.
